title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Tenure Share for Bank Transfers
content:
For a next-business-day transfer to the worker's bank account on the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan, the bank transfer percentage is multiplied by the tenure share:

| Calendar days from the plan's hire date to today | Tenure share |
|---|---|
| fewer than 180 | 80 percent |
| 180 to 364 | 90 percent |
| 365 or more | in full |

The hire date is the one the employer's payroll file reports on the plan.

*Hypothetical:* a bank transfer percentage of 40 percent becomes 32 percent at a tenure of 120 days and 36 percent at 200 days, and stays 40 percent at 400 days. At 179 days the share is 80 percent; at 180 days, 90 percent; at 364 days, 90 percent; at 365 days, in full.
